methodology.Fees: Aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap on routed swaps. Pulled from both ERC20 Transfer events into the fee collector and from native gas-token internal transfers on chains where the indexer covers them.
methodology.UserFees: Aggregator fees paid by users on KyberSwap-routed swaps.
methodology.Revenue: All collected aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All collected aggregator fees retained by KyberSwap.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue share to KNC token holders from aggregator fees.
